# Builder fixtures

Object directories that core copies into a world folder when they are placed in editor mode.

- `barrel/`: the output of `hyprune object import` on `test/fixtures/import/barrel/` (via core's
  `tests/fixtures/imported/barrel`). Author: Hyprune contributors. Licence: CC0-1.0.
- `workspace-screen-wall-16x9/`: the wall screen from the builder kit (hyprune/worlds
  `objects/screens/build.py`). Author: Hyprune contributors. Licence: CC-BY-4.0.
